title: Stand where fear cannot rule
summary: The thieves are conquered and the mind fills with divine light. Stand where illumination, not threat, gets to rule your speech and body.
takeaway: Stand in the light that makes the inner thieves answerable.
lifeApplication: When fear is driving your voice, wait for one breath of clarity before speaking from the old assault.

source.shortMeaning: The terrible inner thieves are conquered, speech becomes sweet, and divine light dawns in the mind.
source.lifeApplication: When fear starts ruling the body, stand still long enough to remember what holds you.

evidence.coreClaim: Fear loses its throne when the inner thieves are conquered and divine light dawns in the mind.
evidence.turn: Call for shelter until fear is no longer the only voice in the room.
evidence.practicalImplication: When fear is driving your voice, wait for one breath of clarity before speaking from the old assault.
